description: Dependency updates follow the shared preset this file extends, pinned to a commit: one Tuesday batch, majors hold the batch for review, security fixes arrive any time. The settings below are the ones specific to this repository.

packageRules.description: main takes changes only through pull requests, so the weekly batch merges its pull request once CI is green instead of pushing the branch to main.
Generator templates pin versions deliberately and are golden-file-tested; they move by hand with a golden re-record.
typescript-eslint pins the typescript API dependency below 7. The tsc-native alias (npm:typescript@7) is matched by depName and stays free.
